name: Robi's Rodelstall
kurzbeschreibung:
**Robi’s Rodelstall in St. Anton am Arlberg**

Experience the thrill of sledding at **Robi’s Rodelstall**, the legendary sledding run in **St. Anton am Arlberg**! Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned pro, this iconic track offers breathtaking views of the **Lechquellengebirge** mountains.

After your ride, warm up with a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** and a hot **Glühwein** at the cozy hut. The perfect mix of adventure and relaxation awaits you!

📍 **Location:** **St. Anton am Arlberg**, **Tirol**
🚡 **Open:** Daily (weather-dependent)
🎿 **Bonus:** Free parking & sled rental available

Come sled with us—where memories are made! ❄️⛷️
